{{Top|leg}}
'''Astrocartography''' was the method of pin-pointing [[Galactic coordinates/Legends|galactic coordinates]] for [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and adjusting [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]] to ensure that [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]] were kept up-to-date on the ever-shifting galactic plane. [[Star/Legends|Stars]] were always in motion, moving around the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] at speeds measured in [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per second. These updates were recalculated and provided by the [[Imperial Space Ministry/Legends|Space Ministry]], which provided these updates for navicomputers for a nominal fee from ministry offices or via download at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. To aid the Space Ministry, route and sensor data from [[Starship/Legends|starships]]' navicomputers were routinely uploaded and collected for analysis by the ministry's [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] bureau.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
